text: Great Crab, Excellent service, friendly environment... be sure to try the wings also.

This place had the Z Squad on today. And they probably always do. I met up with my wife here and asked the bartender if she has a tasty Pilsner on draft. She was somewhere in her 30s, glasses and long dark hair. And she replied "what you see is what I have." So then I found it on the draft list that's he decided to give me after sassing me. So I ordered it and had to help her find the beer. You should know everything you're selling in a restaurant. And if you don't know, you should say "not sure, but let me check." Don't make the guest feel like they're a burden on the staff. Then another staff member came behind the bar, took a two margarita order from two other bar guests and took like six minutes to make just one of them. The management needs to light a fire under these people's asses, man. They're jokers.
Prosciutto sandwich was very good but the apricot jam was a bit too sweet.  High quality ingredients.  Only a few tables outside that have umbrellas.

If you're looking for a Sunday funday spot in the Clearwater beach area, this is definitely your spot. This is a cool little beach club with food and drinks. There was a live DJ performing when we went. There's also a little beach area where you can rent chairs and umbrellas and hang out on the beach. There's a waiter who will bring you drinks to the beach so you don't even need to get up. The food isn't too great so maybe eat before you come. We ordered the chicken nachos and they were extremely dry. 

Overall, great spot to kick back and drink up.

New Jersey has no shortage of restaurants. Properly Fuelled though is a gem. 

The menu is full of healthy flavourful dishes which change seasonally. The environment has the feel of a Brooklyn coffee bar. 

It's one of the few places in Central Jersey where you can get a taste of what's trending in vegan, vegetarian and just all around good food. The bowls are an explosion of flavour, the sauces are perfectly complex. 

Central Jersey has needed a place like this. Long live Properly Fueled.

I have been to this location before  and service isn't always terrible. But tonight they were backed all the way up. I think there were a lot of online orders and they were backed up. We waited an hour for a half pizza and salad. the pizza I got was supposed to have pesto and arugula and they let me know they didn't have the stuff for it after they took it out of the oven. 

They don't have their salads listed--I asked for the caprese salad. Mozzarella,tomato and basil I saw that that's what it was called on the website. The person working at the restaurant was like "is that a fancy word for the ovalini?" Ovalini is a type of mozzarella--not a salad. Then to top it all off they didn't even have the ovalini and we had to get a Caesar salad. 

Someone else we knew was there to pickup food at 6 and had been waiting until 7:30. Staff def needs more delegation for tasks.

I have really enjoyed ordering from this restaurant using a food delivery service during the Covid pandemic. Namaste always reads the additional notes in the order and gets it correct every time. I have been happy to support this restaurant and look forward to returning there. Some of my favorites are the mirchi (breaded stuffed long hot peppers), chili garlic naan, paneer saag, chicken Goan, chicken korma.... why not give it a try? Truly friendly staff as well.

We had a large group celebrating a birthday on Saturday 04/20/19. Diana I believe was our gals name. She was fantastic with our group. All food was ordered and came out as expected. FANTASTIC JOB!

Food was great! Service was excellent!
Amazing food!!! Especially loved the brisket and wonderful service ! The food is a must and the ambiance is really great. Great place for brunch and dinner with friends and family. Went with friends

How is it possible that I've never reviewed this place? 
I go here at least once a month, its so good! Here's how I described it to my brother who was visiting last week from Las Vegas. He mentioned that he wanted good tacos, but didn't want to sit outside and like a taco cart because it was too hot. I said, I have the perfect place! You get taco cart flavor, without the outdoor issues! 
I always order the tacos, all of them are good but my favorite is the carne asada. So flavorful, but not fatty. My husband orders the quesadilla and a carne asada burrito and we share the quesadilla. Not sure why its so good since we only order the plain one with cheese, but its really good! The cheese is fresh and they are not stingy with it, there is plenty to go around! None of their salsas are super spicy but one or two may have a slight kick. Overall, I love this place and recommend it every chance I get!

Was really excited to try this place out. I ordered small beef pho and a mango bubble tea. The bubble tea taste like chalky medicine. I took maybe a max of 5 drinks. The pho was good but could use more meat in it. My husband has teriyaki chicken with fried rice that came out great! I rated a 3 because of the drink and not enough meat in the pho. Was disappointed

We love sushi and have tried a lot of places in Tampa but this is by far our favorite sushi place! We try to go at least once a week and if we are lucky enough to fit it in a second time because it really is that good!

My my, so many negative reviews against this character "Justice", imagine my surprise. Actually no, not all all, what a revolting development indeed. Perhaps you should use more discretion in who and how you hire, and why. Oh well, no loss whatsoever. To quote a popular film, "YOU GET WHAT YOU FUCKING DESERVE!".

LET THE NIGHT ROAR!

I had been wanting to go here for a long time but was met up with a couple of problems. I had ordered a burger with almost nothing on it but it had everything on it. My friend ordered a Croissant Beef and Cheddar and liked almost every part of it but the Croissant was extremely soggy. The fries were delicious. Other than putting everything on the burger and the bread being a little bit soggy, it was delicious.
This is by far my favorite hibachi/sushi place in Tampa thus far. Excellent hibachi and sushi!! Best early bird special as well!

I heard about them serving free slice pizza to kids during lunch time to help with kids not going hungry ! My husband and I are a small veteran business so we understand this pandemic has hurt everyone so we wanted to patron a local business . We were not disappointed my husband called after picking it up and said he might not make it home without taking a bite or two !! Hope you continue to do well !

We ate at this PF Chang's with Family. Our meal was okay, and service was below average. Unfortunately, I got food poisoning from my salt and pepper prawns and spent the night on the toilet. We spoke with the manager twice to let them know, hoping to prevent anyone else from getting sick.  An apology would have been nice, but I was only told that "nobody else had called to complain".  Seemed as though they refused to take ownership. We could have overlooked how dirty the restaurant was, and the fact that some of the employees weren't wearing masks correctly but this is unacceptable. Food poisoning + an unclean restaurant = no recommendation. Will not return. If you are concerned about COVID I would not eat here.
Take out pizza is NOT Mizza pizza!  It was the bogo delivery pizza instead.  Pizza is ok but it is not what I thought I was ordering.  Disappointed.

We ordered food tonight and it took over an hour and a half for pickup. My husband went to pick it up at the time they said it would be ready and still waited over a half hour for it to be ready. Again, this was almost two hours from order time. The food was sub par as well. We've been long time fans of this restaurant but the service and quality weren't awesome. I hope this isn't a sign of what's to come. Totally disappointed.

The most ridiculous thing. They don't take reservations over the phone, fine, but at least make the app user friendly. We were given an estimated time wait of 33 mins once you go through the application process thinking  that by the time we drive and arrive it will be almost time for us to sit. WRONG! after driving 20 mins out of the way we were told it would be an additional 25 mins. Some none sense and a waist of time. They took my information and I got nothing in return, a disappointing experience considering we are on a schedule. This is all part of the customer service aspect of the business and that why they got a one star.

I just moved into the area, never really got anything from this strip mall except firehouse subs. I really wanted a gyro, gave this place a try. Ordered directly off their online menu, that was super easy cause it was done through grub hub. Upon entering, the man at the counter was extremely rude. He asked for my order, I had to repeat it about 10 times, said my name, my order number, the items on the order, even showed him my receipt, and it was as if he didn't believe I had placed an order. After finally receiving my food, I got the Chicago dog and a beef (what I thought was going to be beef) gyro. Chicago dog was ok, bu the beef if you can call it beef gyro was interesting. First of all, super salty, second the "beef" was more like mystery meat. I thought it was beef, tasted more like a breakfast sausage, could've been lamb, was cut into these rectangular slabs. Gyro had a ton of "meat", so that's the only good part. 

I'd go back if I really wanted a hot dog, gyros not so much.

The taste of the sandwiches and sushi is not great, but it's good.  The prices are also on the low end.  If you come here, don't expect amazing food, but know that you'll be satisfied by the low cost.  4/5

Covid-19 has left many of us feeling scared and uneasy, but with Shelter At Home orders lifting and restaurants slowly reopening, I'm happy to report that the Team at Copa is prepared to make you feel not only Safe and Welcome, but right at Home.  The entire staff wore masks and the restaurant is set up so that social distancing measures are followed.  We were greeted with an invisible smile, but you could feel the positive & welcoming energy that our servers displayed, they were absolutely AMAZING!  We started out evening with a Mojvino Cubano and Lil James & The Peach. Each cocktail was delicious and interesting. The Mujvini Cubano is like a tart yet refreshing mojito while the Lil James & The Peach is more like a savory summer lemonade that is more soft and sweet than it is bitter. Delicious!  Not pictured was the Pearle Noir which was my personal favorite!  Coke, Brandy, Pinot Noir, Black Currant, and Orange Curaçao, I thought it was going to be a mistake but I have never been more pleased and surprised! It was sweet but not overpowering, sultry, and smooth. Definitely going to be my go to drink next time I'm at Copa!  For food we ordered Truffle Scallops, Thai Chili Wings, Spring Rolls, Ahi Tuna Tartare, and Fried Calamari.  The Truffle Scallops were my favorite, they were seared to perfection and served on a perfectly toasted croustine with truffle honey arugula that melted in my mouth. Oh my goodness it was fantastic! The Thai Chili wings were a CLOSE second favorite.
This place is upscale away from the flip flop crowd. Dinner restaurant Avery was great wish they would turn up the soft retro crooner music just a notch but great fine dining!

went with some friends for breakfast and at outside. it was so cute and the waitress was very friendly and funny. we got the mimosas which were good and all of our food was amazing! would love to come back

This place is amazing! The apple fritter and the vegan biscuits and gravy were to die for and the staff was so friendly I was astonished. The place itself is amazingly cute and comfortable. I will come here every time I'm in town!

Stumbled upon this place. Being from the bohunk country decided we should check it out. It did not disappoint. Wish we had one in Nebraska. The Kolache's were delicious and so many different choices. We will be stopping again. Before we head home.

Chefs special! Get it! Lots of bang for your buck and delicious. Comes in a bowl, can have lettuce or rice as your base or even a mix. Recommend this place, great food 

Eduard

Great location! Fast service once your done in the line to get in. Churros, mimosas and hot chicken biscuit were amazing!  Coming back for the next visit! Don't wait in line at the original location... Hillsboro location.

Love this place!  Especially when Bobby is working.  He got me addicted to his Irish Coffee. Haha!  We go here quite often and have had many items on the menu.  The Shrimp Kisses, grilled, are the bomb! The pizzas are fresh and tasty and the burgers are excellent!  My favorite right now is the Hot Chicken Salad.  I have to have it once a week! I don't eat grains anymore and they are always willing to adjust my orders to my needs.  You gotta give this place a try!
Second floor balcony dining is wonderful. Awesome view of the Quarter. Food and drug were terrific.
The food is tasty but they use too much salt... Be careful if you have to stay from too much sodium.

The food here is always good no matter what you get. I have tried their Cuban, media niche, deviled crab, stuffed potato, empanada and tamales. All awesome! If you haven't checked them out yet, I suggest you do!
Koree our server was fantastic! I got the southwest omelet and it was delicious. Great atmosphere and great food.

Best Pizza place EVER! 
 I highly recommend. We are absolutely hooked on the pizza creations that are crafted from scratch by Gino since we were lucky enough to find it. Cannot compare to any other in the place in the area. 
He makes most things from scratch. Roast beef, Turkey, Pizza dough, Ciabatta bread,  Tomato Sauce, and so on. I doubt any other Italian place in the area does all that. That's why the taste doesn't compare! 
My only problem is that it's not open 24/7 ;) and it's mostly for pickup and delivery. If I didn't live just a couple miles away I would pickup my food and go to a nearby park and have an inpromptu picnic. You will not regret it. 
Just go there and enjoy ASAP and become as hooked like we did.
Wonderful atmosphere, terrific food, and great service! Kylee was the best server we could ask for, I highly recommend

We went for thanksgiving dinner since it was just the two of us. It was really delicious. We had white and dark meat with dressing, gravy and mashed butternut squash, mashed potatoes, fresh green beans, rolls with compound butter .  Oh yes cranberry sauce too., then there was a delicious pumpkin shooter desert.  The whole meal was so good we couldn't finish it so we took home leftovers for lunch the next day. Yum yum it was even better the second time around. Mike was our server and he was very thoughtful, helpful and made our evening a pleasurable time. I highly recommend Seasons 52 the service and food is very good it is a definite place to go to.

I have been eating at the Truckee location for many years and never had a bad experience. I recently tried the Mill Street spot, ordered online, super easy. My turkey cranberry sando was amazing, the goat cheese salad, perfection. I ordered a tr-tip sandwich. I figured they didn't load it up, so I paid extra for more meat. Well, got it home and there was literally one thin piece of tri-tip on the entire sando, no joke.   Extremely disappointed to say the least, it's just insulting. I have to say, if I go back, I will make sure it's worth the $12 I paid for it. Cmon FBD, y'all can do better!

This is a great place. They were very kind and helpful over the phone regarding gluten-related questions (you can get gluten free soy sauce if you need, just ask or put it in the notes). Comes across as a small family business that focuses on what they know how to do well, the fish was very fresh and they have almond milk boba which is awesome!

If I could give more than 5 stars I definitely would. OMGoodness, everything about chophouse from the moment you walk in with the exposed brick walls to the piano bar everything is perfect. Service is always superb. The servers are very attentive and quick to offer assistance when needed. We started with the seafood platter which consisted of twin 9oz lobster tails ( one fried one grilled), colossal lump crab, baked shrimp, and crab bisque. For entrees we both ordered filet w/ lump crab, creamed spinach and a loaded baked potato. The steak is always delicious and cooked to perfection. The creamed spinach has a hint of nutmeg, yeah yeah I thought it was a strange addition to spinach to, but it was
amazing. 

I could go on and on about chophouse, but I won't keep you reading to long. Definitely one of the best steakhouses in the city!

How do you say overpriced rip off in German?
$18.50 for a liter of dark beer.
Definitely will not be back.
This place is not going to make it. A burger took 30 minutes and two customers in the place. Sad. Overpriced and bad

I've been here a few times now but my most recent trip is one to write about! I came here with a bunch of my girlfriends most of whom are vegetarian or vegan. My friend and I split the vegan mozzarella sticks as an appetizer- they were the best vegan mozz sticks I have ever had- the cheese melted in my mouth and there was a perfect crunch. For my meal I got the vegan wings and a side of vegan meatballs. The wings were some of the best i've ever had- the meatballs were good too but the texture was a bit weird to me. Service was on point and the bill was really affordable. I will be back for sure!
Been here so many times we've lost count.  Why? The food is really good and the drinks are awesome.  But it on your list.
Always the most polite staff here!  I've never had an issue with my order, even during the lunch or dinner rush.

The coffee was good but the service was great!! I just love friendly service! Steven (Stephen) was so friendly. He gave us info on the local houses and made my group of 5 feel at home in the establishment. My cafe au lait was delicious. I loved the little design in the foam. It's the little things the environment was quaint and inviting. A definite asset to Algiers.

Okay the only reason for 4 vs 5 stars was my toast was cold... I couldn't even spread the cold butter.  I didn't say anything because everything else was great.

Sure the prices here are crazy, but your in an airport, so you can't buy a plain coffee without selling a finger.  

The service was very good, of course I was there when they opened at 6am so it isn't like they were packed.   Overall I was very please with the service and the food.

Went to dinner with friends: ordered the fried red snapper. Was very good. Sambrel Indonesian spicy scallops with mixed veggies was amazing. Black bean sauce with atmsfrmpbwas good as well. We were all very pleased with our selection. We also had two orders of spicy tuna rolls which were yummy. Will return ahain

Just wanted two fries and a hamburger. The place is crazy. One person in front of me in line. The girl took their order and then walked away without a word. A lot of people waiting for food to come out. Stood at the counter like five to ten minutes waiting for someone to come back. Finally a guy came and took my order. I am sure I looked impatient but said nothing. When he handed my receipt he said sorry I am one person in an irritated voice and walked off. Now I am wait for my food. I didn't say anything and I was not rude so why the attitude and where did the girl go. It is crazy town in here. If my daughter didn't want this I would not have come. Not a good trip.

I found an inch long HAIR in my sandwich :( Apart from that, everything else was okay, but now I'm wondering what else could be in what I'm eating if I hadn't found it. I will not be going to this Panera again, it's not what it used to be.

Bartender was rude and unprofessional.  As a frequent patron, this is the first time that I've walked out of your establishment having a bad experience.  When asked for Barcadi and Diet Coke he responded, "we don't serve cheap rum here". I'm addition, he disregarded our attempts to order while he was talking about Dungeons and Dragons with another customer than serving anyone else at the bar. We planned to eat and drink as normal, however we were treated terrible so we walked out.
Best Indian food we've found in Indy. Lunch buffet is consistent and very good. Servers are a bit cool and aloof.

Been stopping in here getting there Deli Sandwiches Off an On since Jan 2020  the never fail on quality eats and drinks. My gOO Too sandwich;) is their Hot Italian Panini. 
Great Brocc. Salad

We had a wonderful experience at Forty Five degrees this evening!  The sushi was fresh and delicious.  We ordered the Play Boy Roll, Philadelphia, Spicy Tuna Roll, Rock n Roll, California Roll, Sofia Roll, 45 roll, and Tango Roll.  For us, the favorite was the Rock n Roll.  It's nice to see innovative fun sushi rolls as options.  If you aren't a sushi fan, they have plenty of other options.  Others in our party ordered the orange chicken which they liked. I was surprised to even find a cheeseburger on the menu, which my nephew ordered!! Service was attentive and we felt comfortable even with the new Covid changes. As a side note, outdoor seating is available as well. Thank you for making my niece's birthday celebration wonderful.

I was highly impressed by the quality and quick service of Public Greens past week. I wanted to get carry out, so I placed a order around 6pm and it alerted me that the food would be ready in only 20 minutes. Around that time, we went to pick it up and the back was on the walk-up counter, ready to go. While I wasn't a fan of the food sitting out in the cold, it was still warm since we arrived right in the pick-up time window. The employees were very friendly, as well. 

The food itself was delicious-well cooked and flavorful. My only qualm with the food itself was that my salad (I added chicken) was quite small. Definitely not a full meal. I'd expected it to be w full dish since it was listed with the bowls and was $16. But it was pretty small in comparison with my boyfriend's bowl and the food bowls I've gotten from Public Greens in the past.

I've been to this place a few times over the past few years and it's been very consistent in regards to quality of food! It's located in the West Bank and has its own parking lot with plenty of spots. When you go into the restaurant, you choose your own table and a waiter will greet you shortly after you settle in. There are plenty of tables and while the place does get busy at times, we've always received our food in a timely manner. Recently, I've discovered their amazing wings, which come in several different flavors. Since trying it for the first time, we've ordered the lemongrass wings every time we visit (which is a big deal since I'm a person who never orders appetizers at a Viet restaurant)! The dish comes with about 10 freshly fried wings that are packed with flavor. Definitely something I recommend for everyone to try! I also got a small bowl of pho tai, which was great as well! Broth was very hot when served and still remained warm after we finished our appetizer. Lots of meat in the small bowl of pho! Overall, a great Viet restaurant that I will keep coming back to!

This is a very special bakery in Santa Barbara with the best bread! I love my weekly trips to Oat Bakery. The Almond and Date bread is perfect with cheese. The pumpkin seed bread is the current favorite with the cilantro pesto. The cilantro pesto is a must!!!
Food is always perfect and Friendly workers. I Love this place.

Just here for the 1st time. Service was excellent and food was delicious. Handsome young man (the host)
Joanne, thanks, You're the best. Will definitely be back.

I would definitely return for the Korean Philly.

We got the food delivered via UberEats. It arrived pretty quickly and hot, and the fries were still tasty despite the drive.

I had the Korean Philly, which is similar to a regular Philly cheesesteak but with gochujang mixed into the cheese sauce. It was definitely a winner, just a little spicy, and full of tender meat.

My husband and son had burgers, and my daughter had the chicken nuggets. Their meals were fine. The kids' meals came with fries. They were seasoned curly fries, and my (toddler) kids thought they were a little spicy. Maybe give the option for regular, unseasoned fries? The portions for the kids meals were really generous.
The food there has changed. It is not the Grays of even a year ago. It's just average now. Quite disappointing really.
Had a delicious breakfast with a friend one snowy morning.  Everything was perfect - food, scenery, and service.

I went here with an old friend to catch up and I didn't think to get a reservation, but they were still accommodating. We wanted to sit outside, but they were booked up so they allowed us to sit inside until a table opened outside. We got the truffle fries as an appetizer. Delicious! I got the impossible burger as my entree and the brussel sprouts instead of fries. The burger was so good I thought they accidentally gave me meat. The brussel sprouts tasted as though they were deep fried in grease however. Wasn't a fan. I also got the Lavender Spritz and it was great. I wish I could give this place a 4.5 stars bc the brussel sprouts only took like a .5 off for me. I would definitely recommend!
Dumplings are really good. I think the best ones are pork and chicken!. Really nice for a cold day.

The food is delicious and the chipotle ranch lives up to its reputation as being phenomenal. 

That said, I've been to each location now  and both are quite dirty. Almost every table has food on it, the salsa bar is a disaster, there's trash on the floor, and cobwebs are in all the corners. 

I shudder to think what the kitchen looks like. 

But the food is really delicious.
Holly guacamole! Talk about the best burrito ever! The crispy cheese on top takes the experience to a different universe!!!

My girlfriend and I noticed this small place one day when we were exploring Manayunk and made a reservation that day. When we arrived the interior was decorated like a traditional sushi joint. It was a bit smaller than expected, but that was okay because they have a decent amount of seating (I definitely recommend you make a reservation on busier nights though). 

When we sat down we immediately realized it was a BYOB place and we were kinda disappointed that we didn't know this before arriving (completely our fault for not researching enough before showing up). 

We started off with a bowl of edamame and chicken yakitori which were great (mainly the yakitori since it's kinda hard to mess up edamame). We also ordered two pieces of toro tuna, the waiter came back and told us they did not have any left for the day, so then we asked for their yellowtail belly cuts, to which we got the same response on it being 86ed. Slightly frustrated, the waiter recommended their salmon which was delicious but I was still disappointed because we were looking forward to the toro. We went ahead and ordered a spicy tuna roll, a sea king roll, and scallop canopy roll. They were all great and the ingredients tasted fresh and the rice was cooked perfectly, but the scallop roll seemed to lack the flavor variety I would expect to get out of an 18 dollar roll.

All in-all, I would love to come back and try some of the other rolls. And next time I wont forget the alcohol!
Fast very friendly! Food is delicious, will be going there again! We got the half rack of ribs, beans, pulled pork sandwich and fries! Seriously hit the spot, the house was silent while we ate!

Wow, can't believe how underwhelming this was. We'd heard how great this place was and my husband was REALLY excited to try the Frita sandwich. We got a large Cuban and the Frita to go. My husband placed the order online and when he showed up they looked at him like he was nuts. Needless to say their system needs work. After waiting 20 minutes after placing his order (again) he finally got the food. 

The portions are pretty large, but the quality is awful. The Cuban was one of the worst I have ever had! The ham tasted off, can't really put my finger on it but it just didn't taste right. It smelled weird too. We honestly couldn't even finish it and I am not one to waste food. 

The Frita didn't have the potato sticks as advertised. The meat had a weird texture, kinda like a dry chorizo. 

We will not be returning to this place.
Tried the Catch 13, Crunchy & Luna. These choices were awesomely delicious. We'll try the rest of specialty rollls next time

Attentive staff and interesting menu choices. The food was delicious! Definitely not your standard diner fare. They also give you fair warning with the calorie count on the menu. Prices are higher than your standard diner, but it's worth the few extra bucks. Definitely worth a visit.

This was on 5/6/19 - Staying in the hotel for a business meeting. My first encounter was great. Very attentive bar staff and food was actually really good. 
However when I came back later for a bite to eat and a night cap I was met with a very different experience. Unfortunately I was sitting next to a very intoxicated gal, and apparently the bartender thought I was as well based off his treatment and attitude.

Great place to go for studying or meetings with folks especially during COVID.its clean and nice and quiet plus the coffee and food options are solid! Give it a shot for your next sip of coffee, inside seating is available.
The food was uninspired.  No crispy veggies, no delicious sauce.  So many opportunities in Asian cooking to add flare, to add some love, but all the dishes we tried looked and tasted quite bland.

I normally don't write a negative review as I like to praise the good. But for fellow travelers who get encouraged by the overall good reviews of City Fire I felt the need to warn you. Do not order the "Smothered Comfort". It's described as a  southern mash up of comfort food that sounds like comfort food on steroids. Instead, what you get is like a teenage kid grabbed some stuff out of the refrigerator and piled it together to power a hunger fit. Hot skillet chicken that was cool and worse than a fast food chicken sandwich.  Open faced turkey that was a clump of cold deli meat.  Cheese that had been warmed up and then congealed to cold with some bacon stuck in there like fruit pieces in jello.  All resting on a semi fresh slice of French bread. Just sayin the worst meal  I've paid for in awhile. On the plus side, comfortable ambience and nice service, bumping a one star to two. 

Be warned - Smothered Comfort is really a confused teenager's refrigerator stuff mash up.

This review is for the self-guided tour and farm store. After reading about the self-guided tour (thanks again, Yelpers!), we started our visit at the Farm Store. For $3, we got a map that clearly outlines a 1.5 mile loop. I was a little concerned about missing markers, etc., and getting lost, but the trail was mostly clearly marked and easy to follow, especially with the great tips from the lovely woman at the counter.Along the way, we got to see cows and their calves, the big red barn, roosters, hens, more cows, bulls, a beautiful creek, and a majestic old oak. A great little trek for me and my baby. Warning: this is not a path for strollers. But, with a baby carrier, it was a great little jaunt. And this time of year (fall), with the leaves turning, it was BEAUTIFUL! Afterward, we stopped at the farm store again for an afternoon snack - mineral water and a delicious oatmeal pecan cookie - and some cheese to take home. Such a lovely visit!
My family eats here once a week.  The facility is small but we get takeout.  The service is always amazing and food is the best.  Never had a messed up order ever and absolutely love the food.

Came here and my daughter got the pizza. Ordered and picked up in about 10 minutes total. Nice size personal pizza that was quite delicious. Staff was friendly and welcoming. This is a good truck type facility so you order, grab your food and find a seat on the patio. 

The Wharf was very crowded the day we went and my hubs and I didn't get to enjoy the food that we hoped to try however would we return, yes. And maybe next time we'll have more pizza.

This was our first time here. From the second we walked in I knew I was about to get some good eats. The entire staff was kind. From the girls at the counter, to the cooks, to the owners greeting each guest I was impressed. The menu was fairly priced, especially for the size of the wings! Beer on tap as well! The homemade ranch is delicious. I will never visit another wing stop!

Love the blueberry pancakes! Their scones are the best too. Fun attentive staff, great local vibe. While I love this place and want to support them, I was reluctant to leave a review. Kind of want to keep this place all mine!

I ordered lunch from here this week and it was delicious! I ordered their Plato with black beans, rice, chicken tinga (this chicken is spicy), guac, cilantro, and pico de gallo. They put each ingredient in the container separately so it traveled well and everything was so fresh! They also included the attached note which made me even happier to have supported them during this scary time. In a world where you are told the only good you can do is stay home, ordering from places like this makes your positive impact even greater. Happy to support them now and in the future!

Are you kidding me right now?? I ordered 3 things from this place and only got 2 things. I ordered wings, fries, and a pizza. The pizza was not delivered and they calling us liars!! I am super pissed and would never prefer from them again!

From the outside it's hard to tell there's a restaurant inside, almost looks like an abandoned building. Inside it's definitely got a hipster, eclectic vibe. Agree with the other reviews about a bit disorganized with the crew but they were extremely  friendly and helpful.  The food was very good, my boyfriend had the banana bread French toast and I had the blueberry waffle. Portion sizes were pretty big, I could only eat about half of my waffles. I will be back, want to check out their vast selection of sandwiches and salads.

We stopped in for a late dinner on a Saturday night. The indoor atmosphere is nice to look around & it wasn't crowded so seated quickly. Music was being played. The food (NY strip & prime rib) was all right. Our server Whitney was great (that made this a 4 instead of a 3)! Good for a low key date night & I'd come here again, but only if we could get the early menu. Over $70 for a fairly basic meal & we didn't have drinks.

I ordered a dosa and was thinking I was ordering a samosa. I called and they politely explained that I had it wrong. So I tried something different and it was delicious. I will definitely try other things on the menu. Good food, good service!

Honestly you could eat the whole menu and everything would be perfect. 10/10

Love the staff, atmosphere and desserts. My go to on a night I don't want to cook.

Avoid this place: cashier (who I'm sure was the owner) had no personality and hesitated to give us back our complete change due to not having .75 cents in quarters. My wife rummaged through her purse really quick and offered to give him .22 cents to receive a dollar back and he said "oh.. sorry.." Pathetic! Aside from that, it was way overpriced, food was cold and took FOREVER to arrive at our table, and they never once offered to refill my coffee. 

What good is "organic" food if it arrives cold to your table? We come to Santa Barbara once a year and I will definitely 100% SKIP this place in the future.

UPDTE: I changed this review from 1 star to 3 star because the owner emailed me directly to apologize for the situation.

Jersey Mikes has always employed kind and energetic people. Today, however, I encountered possibly the worst food service employee I have ever experienced. Upon entering this location, we were greeted by a young man without a mask on chilling on his phone who said "F**K" and rolled his eyes when we entered, then ran his hands through his hair before making our meals. He then said "What do you want!" in a toxic attitude. Once we got to the toppings he once again said "What do you want!" with the same unacceptable attitude while slamming around all of the items. Just as I was thinking "wow this guy needs a major attitude adjustment" another patron gladly let him know that he needs to be nicer and speak to customers in a better tone. As that man exited I was the only one left in the building and the kid loudly expressed that the patron who called him out was a "stupid a**". When he rung us up, we were once again greeted with a terrible attitude and asked "What did you get!". We didn't even bother asking for corrections because we didn't want to face this kids rudeness any more. This behavior is not what you expect when going to a Jersey Mike's and shouldn't be tolerated. On the way out we overheard the "stupid a**" customers saying they were never going to return to this location because "this is a really great place to eat but the negativity really spoils th

This venue is not only excellent for getting a unique bite, but the atmosphere really enhances your experience. From the creative design of hosting 6 different restaurants to serve their guests, while maintaining a luxurious dining hall setting; The Hall's crafty selections of drinks encourages you to accompany your meal(s) with a beverage that leaves you wanting to order another masterpiece  to your table or even head over to the collection bar after! 

The staff is kind and attentive to the customer's requests. Being that there is a variety of restaurants to choose from in one space at The Hall, each chef is wanting to leave a lasting impression on their customer's taste buds! 

My favorite restaurant within The Hall is Fork & Hen. Their thick cut bacon is to die for, while their chicken pot pie presented in an acorn squash cup will make your mouth water! 

Great spot for big groups, smalls groups, date night or even a solo outing to grab a bite and get some work done. I come with friends & family, sometimes to get some work done and even take my staff here for employee appreciation events and they beg to return monthly! 

I highly recommend this spot! Not to mention it sits in the heart of Tampa! As a local  of Tampa, I'd add it to your regular spots to visit; even if your just looking for a tasty milk shake (accompanied with a Nutella waffle s) it should hands down be one of your places to visit!!
WOW! What an amazing time. Everything was top notch. We brought our two teenagers and the table side magic had them thinking all night.

My favorite Zeas and they never disappoint me. Service was right on time. The hostess is so friendly. She highly recommended to Thai ribs. She was so excited about how good they were that I changed my order from half to latter order. Schacora made me feel right at home while I sat at the bar and ordered Duck Empanades and happy hour Z Rita

Order my food Togo but I opened each order and it looked dilicioud
They give you fat portions that is the size of a newborn baby. Their food is always made fresh! They're also open late night so that's a huge plus.

This was my second time to Mr. An's. It's always a good experience. The scenery is nice. The bar patio is fun while your waiting for your table. Our server was having a bad day. She brought out the wrong appetizers and 1 wrong entree but the food made up for it. Mr. An walked around taking pictures and shaking hands. He's definitely a little celebrity in the area. If you haven't tried it I definitely recommend it.

The best place for seafood!
Amazing service but even better is the food. We had Mahi Mahi and Florida Steam Basket. Their dessert are home made.

We were pleasantly surprised by this place. Looking for a quick to-go meal on our way to a show nearby, we called ahead and "ordered blind" being unfamiliar with the restaurant's menu. There were six of us and everyone was pleased with their burritos (we had 4 different combinations altogether). I would definitely go back.
this place is good. v instagramable. v yummy. i haven't been  back since my  first time, but ill for sure  go back. they also typically have some daily deal or something.

Stopped in here for brunch with my wife for the first time...we decided to order several things from the menu to give us a better idea of the variety.  Needless to say, we were extremely happy with everything, and I'll let the pics tell the story

My family took me here before I had to fly out. We were waiting for an hour. The service was very bad and our order did not get taken. They put their online orders in and take care for them before customers sitting in the dinning area. We left without being served. 

To anyone who is hungry, I recommend you go somewhere else.
Great BBQ, fantastic sides. Really some of the best St Louisan's have worked here and they consistently put out great food
This place is excellent. Great drinks. Yummy pasta. Fresh and homemade. Service is wonderful. I'd definitely return.

I've been a customer at Pizza Baron for many years. This evening I received a delivery that I wasn't very happy with, my wings were pretty bad, they were not very fresh, possibly a reheat and not to mention the size of each piece (very small) inferior, it's pretty sad when only about 40% of each wing was edible. I'm not going back.

Poke wasn't bad, regular sized bowls are a good size for the price. The zoodles are a nice twist. Was a bit disappointed that they didn't offer any Wasabi, and also felt like their marinade selection was limited. Miso soup was waaay too salty. Good Agua frescas though. Will probably be back,.
Ordered delivery. Cheesesteak and fries were cold when it arrived. Basically flavorless food. I would not order again.

We went to this location today, ordered through drive thru. When we got home we realized we only got half order in one of our fries! This is so not acceptable! Not only that one of the sauce was half open. Seems like they just gave us someone's leftovers
Sky Cafe is one of my favorite restaurants. The food is excellent, the prices are reasonable, and the management is very sweet. Try the Nasi Bungkus!

Great place. Good service. Excellent appetizers for sure. We ordered almost all of the appetizers. My favorite was the liver mousse with bacon and cherries on toast. A real treat. Such a funky flavor was the real attraction for me. 

Our waitress was terrific. Attentive and accommodating, she made us feel welcome. No request was too insignificant. 

My qualm: The NY strip special of the evening. First off, the meat was tough and had gristle. I understand it can happen in steak, but for $50 I expect a tier above the rest. I should have said something, but I didn't. My mistake. 

Bottom line:. An awesome place with some seasonal, innovative plays on American food. It's a great joint, but for steak, I'll stick with other venues.

I really wasn't expecting much looking at the exterior of this place & being generally disappointed with Asian cuisine in this region for over a decade here.  

I'm originally from Westchester County, NY & the cuisines I grew up with were always top notch in their categories.  That said, the food here is good.  I ordered a salmon sushi roll, spare ribs, shrimp with vegetables & egg foo young.  All tasted fresh & properly seasoned & prepared.  The items were packaged properly & the staff was pleasant.  Social Distancing is well enforced with a no contact pick up station/window with a double door case.  If you pay cash you will get a 10% certificate-good on your next visit.  

The reviews on several social platforms are either outdated or all over the board.  I asked people in my township & the majority said it was worth the ride. (8 miles).   I gave 4 stars because it met my expectations for this area.  If you were to visit a large metropolitan area it probably wouldn't measure up to gourmet but if you have a taste for Chinese/Japanese/sushi to go this will fit the bill.
Delicious food, great service, and perfect location.  Going back next time I'm in Santa Barbara. Would definitely recommend!

If you don't want to have to go to some strip mall cheesy joint, this is a pretty decent Chinese restaurant. Food quality is pretty good, the way they make their beef is really good, the inside could really use some updating to make it modern, but you go there for the food

Worst bar and management for a fledgling franchise we have ever experienced. Took 10 friends to watch college football and ALCS  on a Friday night. Stopped serving us their watered down drinks after 3 hours saying we were over-served. Not true when each person has 3 drinks. Food is mediocre at best as well. Never encountered a place that was more interested in closing at 10:45 before when nobody was there and they close at 12. Last visit and will spread the word to any and all in South Tampa.

I don't know how I missed this spot for so long, but I'm glad I found it today! I have been craving a burrito for days and this one hit the spot. It's not so big that you wanna die after eating it, and it's delicious enough that you can't not eat the whole thing. Highly recommend.

Was going to order from my regular Thai place (in Sparks) but decided that I should try a new place and I'm so glad I did!

I placed an order for pickup:
+1 pad thai with chicken (0 spicy)
+1 pad kee mao with beef (3 spicy)
+1 Tom kha gai (3 spicy)

Not long after I called in my order, I was on my way to pick up the food. I didn't interact much with the staff but the cashier/waitress was very kind when I paid for the food. 

The food was fantastic! The only thing that would have made the experience better was if the tom kha gai was a bit spicier and included more veggies. My mom's order of pad thai was refreshingly good. I forgot that pad thai could taste good, honestly. I never order pad thai because usually I find it too bland and sweet. This one was nicely spiced and not overly sweet. (Yes, I know that all pad thai has a lot of sugar in it.) My pad kee mao was perfect -- balanced noodle-meat-veggies ratio, adequately spicy, savory & flavorful. 

I plan to come back in the future.

Ordered lunch with 3 of my co workers an hour after  the order was placed got a message that the order had been canceled. I understand things happen but should have been made aware before food was scheduled to be delivered. Our orders were all only burgers and frys nothing extreme this was my second time attempting to eat here my first visit when i went and picked up my food was equally as bad and only ordered today bc we all have off days so thought i would give them another chance...  bad idea Now  there is no lunch and trying to get anywhere in Green hills at lunch time on a break is difficult thanks shake shack we really wanted disappointment for lunch

We love Drago's. We had it to go during COVID. The chargrilled oysters and crawfish Mac n cheese are to die for! 
When we dine-in I always go for the lobster, sometimes the lobster with crabmeat.
Great food, great service, inviting atmosphere. Definitely a must for authentic Japanese noodles, especially on the west side. Great addition to the neighborhood. Also lots of parking.

i found this place one day when i was having a pizza craving and i refused to drive to North Jersey for pizza i'm used to. i noticed that the concept for this place is very similar to what i had living in North Jersey at a place called "Blaze Pizza" so i figured this couldn't be that different. i placed my order online which was simple enough. same basic concept as Blaze. choose your crust, your sauce, type of cheese and any number or toppings and the pizza gets fire grilled pretty quickly. when i received the notification that the pizza was finished i went inside the restaurant and the pizza was sitting on a table to the side for people to see their name, grab their box and go. i ordered a pretty basic pepperoni pizza topped with pesto sauce. overall i would say the pizza was decent. i'm a pizza fanatic and this pizza didn't even satisfy me. even being cooked the way it was i still found the crust slightly soggy which was odd. the concept may be the same as Blaze but the taste is far off. probably wouldn't go there again.

Went to Homegrown Taproom with a good friend of mine and had some beers after work. It was my first time here (yes, I was a homegrown virgin), just gotta say that this place is a very laidback and comfy place to hangout and drink great beer and eat excellent food with friends. The friend I went here with calls it their personal CHEERS bar. And it is exactly what you would think, everyone knows everyone.

The first thing that I have to say is, who knew that Donnelson had such a cool hang out? They even have another separate room for darts, if you're into that? But if not get ready for a night of great beers on tap and like I already said, some amazing food for a taproom. They have everything from fabulous sandwiches like the Jackson (a great twist on the traditional French dip), to downright killer burgers and salads, to Wait for it...to die for shrimp and grits!

Not only is the ambience relaxed and fun, but on Tuesday's they have two for one night and Thursday's they have trivia. (I'm not sure what's happening the other nights of the week, these are just the two things that I learned about on my first visit. It may have been my first, but it certainly won't be my last! CHEERS  Homegrown!

To be direct: best skewers in Philadelphia! 

The lamb is tender and juicy. And all skewers are amazing at their spiciest level. The hotpot is also yummy, but I could've order more condiments to make it more full. 
Hole in the wall with limited seating but it's perfect to walk around and munch on yummy skewers, or they will wrap them perfectly in foil and a bag to go. The workers/owners are insanely nice. 

If you're looking for cheap and tasty snack/meals and more authentic Chinese flavors this is it.
Finally got back to our favorite place and it didn't disappoint.   We felt very comfortable and safe.  The food and service was awesome as usual.  Pasquale and his family are simply the best!

A must!! Last minute wanted to find a outside seating dinner reservation and stumbled upon little nonna's... exceeded expectations! Food was amazing, service was great, and great atmosphere. Gnocchi are a must and the chicken was great too. Great drink menu! Definitely will go back!!!

Really incredible food! A lot of ramen i've had the noodles are pretty tasteless, but these noodles were so good and flavorful. I got the shrimp noodle soup and my boyfriend got the sliced chicken noodle soup and we loved both. Super fresh ingredients. And for the prices this place really cant be beat. This has definitely become out ramen spot!

Lunch was good!   I had the special of half a chicken with baked beans and chips.  My husband had the tenderloin with fries.  Both were very filling.  Waitress was very nice and attentive.   Fabulous experience!

We had the chicken parm the gulf fish of day which was Mahi and was very please both dishes were very tasty. I love the red gravy. I had the French onion soup which was very delicious. My significant other he had the sweet potato and andouille sausage soup and that was outta this wooded good.  I tasted it and I'm not a fan of sweet potato but omg it was good. We also had the friend crab stuffed mushrooms one word yummy!!

So salty. Like it had been sitting under the warmer for hours. Mac salad was not good. I just can't get over how salty everything was. The hawaiian place is nampa-Island Kine Grinds- is 100 times better and the food tastes fresher.

I have been a fan for awhile but now I live around the corner which could be very dangerous! I love the pick up option so I can get what I want and grab it on my way home. I can honestly say I have always had something I really liked here. My favorite was the Obento boxes we would pick up for lunches at work. Its the perfect first sushi for someone as it is mostly cooked fish and shrimp. Planning to surprise my daughter with a trip there next week.

We went to this Benihana for a 6 year olds birthday party. It was very good on working with us on the reservation and being seated in a timely fashion. 

Where it went awry was the service. When you go to Benihana you want the authentic experience and you expect someone of Asian decent to do the table show. This was not the case. I have no doubt that anyone can get it done, but only certain people can do it with precision and expertise. This guy was not very good or experienced and it showed. 

The food was just okay and I will not be recommending this place to others as it is pricey and not professional enough for me.

Service was wonderful food no wouldn't go back had to call my uncle who is a professional chef to tell him how salty this food was the wait staff is great chefs need to be taught how to measure out their seasonings and how to do costumers they actually care about what they are serving presentation is great but the taste I was offered to eat something else and I dented cause I didn't see anything appetizing after ordering a breakfast burrito that I didn't even touch. The mimosa was the best thing I had on the menu today

Let me start by saying I've had a LOT of BBQ. Texas, Florida, Kansas City, South Carolina, Georgia, etc. I always get the brisket, because I think that's the true test of good BBQ. 

Nothing has even come close to competing with 4Rivers in Florida for brisket. Until now. 

This place was really good. The flavor of the brisket was better than 4Rivers. Not quite as tender, but still very good -- and about half the cost! Seriously, I think I have a new favorite brisket. 

Super nice people and great service, too! Go check them out!

I've been going to Soochow x years....it is my favorite Chinese restaurant in Reno/Sparks.  Can't say much about most of the menu since I stick with my outstanding favorites....vegetarian egg rolls, sweet and sour shrimp, crispy eggplant (particularly good in my view), broccoli in garlic sauce and their great steamed rice.  Always friendly and consistently good.

The new owners did a nice job decorating the space and with use of antique looking service ware and utensils.  The space gets loud when at least half the restaurant is full due to the acoustics so it can get a little difficult to hear across the table.  The food was ok.  Flavors were good but execution could have been better.  Ordered the foies gras appetizer and it had a nice sear but the inside was still cold.  The veal pasta was good and the risotto was nicely done was well.  The amount of truffle used on the risotto was pretty slight.  The steak entree was good but tiny.  The creme brûlée had the nice crispy sugar topping but the custard was not set so it tasted soupy.  The price is very reasonable for the quality of food but the quantity of food is disappointing.  I left hungry and not sure if I would go back or not.

I can't in good conscience recommend this place. Service was fine, but food and cleanliness really awful! Definitely a lot of people drinking there. So it's really more of a bar. Which is great if that's what you are looking for. I asked for my table to to be wiped and the manager (who was 3 sheets to the wind) to me to "ask one of my girls." So disappointed. Definitely prefer Broke and Bored up the street.

The desserts are pretty decent but everything is overshadowed by how rude the staff is. I went with a group for a friend's birthday. The staff seemed angry to have people in the restaurant. They were impatient in taking orders and unwilling to give recommendations or answer questions. Needless to say, none of us will be returning.

Meh, I don't know how these guys got all of the four and five star reviews but I was there and the service is horrible and the food is mediocre at best. 
The chili omelette was delivered like warm and the toast wasn't even toasted. The waitress delivered a cup of coffee over my nephews head and spilled it. Fortunately she missed him. 

Find another place I'd you want a great breakfast!
Great day to have a cup of coffee and work outside. We were able to order our coffees and find a place to sit outside to enjoy the great weather this morning.

I know they just opened so understandable they they are still getting it together. However, we had a pretty large group near the bar and our waitress was less than helpful. Showed no initiative and appeared very inconvenienced when we tried to order something. We thought maybe we were at a bar service table so we tried to order from the bar, we were told no, you have a waitress. This place is overpriced and also make sure you ask for parking validation for the garage next door (no info for parking on the website) or else you will pay $16 for two hours... hope they can improve and make this place feel a bit more welcoming to nashvillians.

This place is going down hill fast!  Stopped in w two friends for dinner tonight.  The place was complete empty- flag.  Asked the " waiter" what was in the Mongolian Beef and he didn't know.  I ordered it anyway and my two companions ordered honey chicken and orange chicken, respectively.  The chicken was awful and both dishes were identical:  small nuggets of fried(not crispy) chicken with no taste and spongy texture.  One bite of the MB and it was over.  I pushed it aside after the second bite of spoked meat and rotting scallions!  Terrible - just horrid food.  The place was never gourmet but tonight it was dirty, awful and bordering on in need of the Health Deot!

Hadn't been back to my old stomping grounds in awhile, so I thought "Charity's Comeback" (joke) karaoke night on Thursdays sounded like a winner. And Whiskey Business delivered like it always has... Good fun vibes, strong drinks, friendly bartenders, pool, darts, and, of course, the karaoke.
The crowd was small but lively for the karaoke 9pm start-time. People were dancing, playing pool, and already singing when I walked in. And the party had patrons chilling to music and just enjoying the warm evening settling in. 
I was able to get a song in without too much wait, and that's pretty amazing! I did notice that it was different karaoke people than last time, and it was n
ot your usual karaoke crowd; not a bad thing, just an FYI. (I think I prefer the previous crew, but, that is just a side-note). 

If you're looking for a Karaoke Thursday, good drinks any day, lots of t.v.s to catch the game, a patio bite, music on the juke-box while grabbing some eats, or live-music... It's here.

My likes? The fried pickles and Bloody Mary's. I am never disappointed. 

Check their website for event info!

Be safe. Be smart. Be generous. Be kind.

The food was super delicious and fast efficient pickup service during these coronavirus times. The cowbell burger was so juicy and flavorful as well as the fries and the Mac and cheese was super cheesy and melt in your mouth. Will order from Cowbell again.

Everything was okay or meh but for the amount spent it was kind of disappointing. I had gotten the shrimp scampi and it was kinda watery and most of my shrimp wasn't clean. Someone had gotten the Risotto Pescatore and became ill afterwards, not to mention the scallops were sandy, the rice was way over cooked and it didn't really taste like much. Also it seemed kinda packed and didn't really seem like they were following the guidelines for 6 ft apart
Quick seating. Service was average. Food was average as well. Not a bad place but not a place that is anything special compared to other Vietnamese food places. Good presentation.

Started going to Mary's when I was younger, Now 40+, I go 3-4 times a week for breakfast and I've never had a disappointing experience. Management, Waitresses, Waiters, Cooks, Bus people, and Cashiers are all professionals and very friendly. Had my Son's Graduation dinner at Mary's yesterday and it was truly a wonderful day. 40 plus people enjoyed their food and I'll bet those who have never been there will definitely go back. Great reviews to me as they were leaving. Carlena, her Brother and their staff are excellent. Thanks especially to Rihanna for the awesome job she did waitressing this dinner.

It's happening again....I'm eating, I'm drinking, I'm sitting in the restaurant and I'm reviewing. I feared my first experience was too good to be true but here I am 7 months later and I'm back in heaven!

The food is great.
The staff is super friendly.
The wine is delicious. 
The atmosphere is lovely.

I got the Happy Hour $5 gumbo and compressed watermelon + pork belly salad. Good God man. The FLAVORS! The cup of gumbo looked small but it's taking me forever to eat, it's just too good to rush. And I don't know what it is about this pork belly but it's like crunchy, fluffy, borderline-guiltless meat fat. That's a raging compliment in case it didn't translate. It's just TOO good to care about calories (and I care *a lot* about calories).

I'm heartbroken to say that I will no longer be working in Arizona come 2021 but I plan to "vacation" in Tucson just to eat here. It's too yummy to just be a good memory.

KEEP DOING WHAT YOU'RE DOING PARISH!! If you ever expand, please come to San Diego.

I arrived pretty quick and my order was ready when I got there. I ordered takeout from the Yelp app so I didn't speak to anyone there, I guess that's my fault. I ordered the lamb skewers, scallion pancakes white rice and Mama's dumplings which the menu says were shrimp. The menu failed to mention that the dumplings are also made with pork which my family and I do NOT eat. I asked the person that handed me my order at the door if they had shrimp or pork and she said "yes", then she yelled something to a table filled with men in the back of the restaurant and she added "shrimp AND pork. I'm mad because I expected the menu to include vital information such as that. The scallion pancakes were very crispy and tasted ok, the lamb skewers were here chewy and spicy, the General Tso's chicken was brighter in color than I'm used to and harder then I'm used to and the rice was well white rice. I don't have anything special to report about that. I don't think anyone can ruin whites rice except my sister. The dumplings hit the trash before I closed the door to my home so I cannot give you a review on those.

So the shakes are great, presentation is perfect but they're very pricey! Food is ok, I Hope is because they just opened but service is super, super slow! I think is better treated as a dessert kind of place rather than a restaurant

Portillo's is the kind of place you'll either love or just fell "meh" about it. They've got a few random items on their menu like ribs when they're known for their Italian Beef sandwiches and Hot Dogs. If it's your first time, you've got to try the Italian Beef! I like mine with extra gravy, hot and sweet peppers, and cheese! If your looking for something "lighter" the salads are great and come in a pretty large portion! The chopped salad is one of my favorites. This seems like a place I'd take the family after a ball game for dinner. Good, clean restaurant and the staff are always friendly! 
Portillo's is what one might call the In-N-Out of the Midwest. It gets packed during the lunch and dinner hours, especially on the weekends. You're sure to enjoy anything on their menu!

Obviously Popeyes is a staple in New Orleans! This particular location, I had ordered the butterfly shrimp  and it wasn't ready so they told me to pull up to the side. I waited and waited and waited, probably almost 20 minutes!! The manager came out and asked what I got, I gave her my receipt and she refunded me and then they brought out my whole meal plus more! I was so upset but I didn't express how upset I was for waiting so long! Totally changed my mind! How nice this was and how nice the employees were that day.

Went there tonight for the first time with my boyfriend and the service was EXCELLENT. As soon as we were sat I let the server know it was our first time, and asked her for advice on which menu items she recommended. If it's your first time they give you a complimentary buffalo chip dip, which the manager delivered and gave us a warm welcome. The manager also brought over a card for a free app for our next visit and also checked in with us again after we got our food to see how everything tasted. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone! Can't wait to go back.

After 3 months quarantined in New York City.. This place made me feel what i was missing so much .. That is dining in a 1st class restaurant. Food was excellent.. service was great.. and perfect seating outside.  Not much more you can ask for .. No attitude just a great menu .. simple and good.

Relatively slow day after their grand reopening. Arrived to parking lot and seen two employees out back by drive through smoking. Entered to the order counter, female taking order had hickies on both sides of her neck. Placed order and received my burger, which tasted like someone poured a container of salt onto it prior to putting the cheese on.   Only bright side was the milk shake, kinda hard to mess that one up.

This is probably my favorite place to get a shrimp po boy in the quarter. The shrimp are perfectly breaded/cooked, the rolls fresh, and the remoulade and hot sauce make it next level. There are many things that look amazing on the HUGE menu. Bring cash and don't step to the counter until you're ready to order, lol.
